transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in today?

Um... I don't know. My mom wanted me to come. I just... I can't really make myself do anything anymore. 

I mostly just sit in my room. Usually in the same clothes. I used to knit, or journal, or go walking, but... I don't do that now. And when my mom asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to even answer her. So she brought me here.
How long has it been since you started feeling this way—weeks, months, or longer?
Um... longer. I guess... it started when I tried doing a community-college program. That was... about two years ago. Maybe two years and a couple of months. I don't know.
Over these past two years, has your mood and lack of energy been pretty much constant every day, or have there been stretches—even a few weeks—where you felt more like your usual self?
Um... I don't really know. It's just... mostly the same, I guess. I don't really pay attention to it.
Have you ever had a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, even if it felt good at the time?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't get energetic like that. I'm just tired mostly.
Do you have any medical conditions—like thyroid problems, head injuries, or other illnesses—or take any medications, drugs, or alcohol regularly that might be affecting your mood or energy?
Um... no. I don't have any of that. I don't... I don't take anything.

During these past two years, has there been any specific stretch of at least two weeks where your mood or symptoms felt noticeably worse than your usual baseline—like more severe sadness, changes in appetite or sleep, or thoughts of death?
Um... I don't think so. I don't really keep track of time like that. It's just... always kind of the same.
Right now, are you noticing any changes in your sleep or appetite—like sleeping much more or less than usual, or a big change in how much you're eating?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I sleep when I can. I don't really pay attention to how much I'm eating. It's just... normal, I guess.
Have you been having any thoughts that you're worthless, or thoughts about death or not wanting to be alive?
No. I don't... I don't think about that.
Over these past two years, have you noticed trouble concentrating or making even simple decisions, like what to eat or wear?
Um... no. I don't really think about it. I just... I just put on whatever is there. It's not hard.
